cards: The weald is a mysterious place, thus we know so little of its denizens and plants. Rumor has it that a mysterious type of fungus grows in its dark crevasses. Thus, you need to collect as many samples as you can to be tested. We only hope that they give us further insight as to what we have to combat.

Objective Rooms are rooms [weald]3, [weald]6 & [weald]8. Upon entering, randomly choose one and discard it once secured. Win Battles there with at least one unsmashed Necrotic Fungus to gain the objective.
The cackling of these mad crones can still be heard through the dark woods. People are already afraid of them and their malevolent rituals. Venture through the Weald, and stop their horrific seance.
Objective Room is always room [weald]9. Spawn a Crone (LvL 2) when Battle starts there.

Not even the vegetation of the Weald can stand against the seeping corruption of the evil that lives deep in its groves. Majestic oaks have been tainted, but they can still be saved. Take potions and pour them onto their roots. Let the healing magic undo what the dreadful darkness has done to these majestic trees.

Objective Room is always room [weald]5. Start this Quest with 3 additional [potion] Provisions. A Hero must spend one action and a [potion] when in Area [red-area] of the Objective Room to disinfect the oak.

Vicious monsters litter the grounds of the Weald, and yet we stand helpless against their brutality. No more. Head in there, amidst the trees, find and eradicate them. Bring an end to their madness and hope to our hearts.

People are afraid of the Weald as it stands dark, foreboding and unwelcoming. We need light, we need you. Traverse the dark groves and look out for the danger that lurks within its foliage. Eradicate the monsters and ensure that we sleep yet one more night...
When Battle starts, roll a [d10]. If you rolled over your [light] Level, place all Monster Initiative Cards on top of the deck for the first round of Battle.

The Hag's dark blessings are only spread by one of her hateful agents, the dreaded Virago. One that brings desolation and despair over the Weald. A harbinger of doom, death and decay. Find her, kill her, bring her reign to an end.
In Objective Rooms spawn a Hateful Virago (LvL 3).

Glimmering in the dark is the loot that the fiendish monsters have managed to collect. All tokens of their attacks against our Hamlet. These lost treasures are ours though, and you will bring them back to us. We implore you, take them from their clutches and bring them back to our Hamlet in honor to those who have fallen in service to our safety.
In Treasure Rooms, spawn only Level 2 Monsters.
What lies ahead underneath the mantle of darkness? Venture through the cursed woods, find out what dangers lie in wait, and deal with them once and for all!
Fill the rest of the Room slots with random Rooms. Spawn only [weald] Monsters in Lairs.

The howling you hear from deep within the woods belongs to the rabid mongrels that hunt in the night. No game can be found, for our hunters are hunted down by these malevolent predators. Deal with them, lest we die of starvation.
Objective Rooms are Rooms [weald]1, [weald]3 & [weald]6. Upon entering, randomly choose one and discard it once secured. Spawn 3 Rabid Gnashers there.

A convoy filled with much desirable supplies should have arrived a moon ago. Yet we dare not enter the outskirts of the Weald. Can you brave the danger, traverse the woods and find the convoy? What happened to it? Are there any supplies that you can bring back to us safe and intact?

Do not roll for Provisions for this Quest other than those gained by the Survivalist or other Skills. Use only Rooms with Loot Chests for this Quest. When looting a Chest, roll for two random Provisions instead of their normal Loot. When returning to the Hamlet and gaining Xp for the Provisions you brought back, you'll also gain the 1[gold] per Provision as normal.

Sometimes corruption seeps deep into one's skin beyond salvation, and even the trees are not an exception. These proud oaks once infected should be burned down to the ground. Otherwise, if a malevolent spirit possesses them, it might be too late for us all...

Objective Room is always room [weald]5. A Hero must spend an action and a [torch] when in Area [red-area] to set the oak ablaze. Heroes must wait until the end of the next round for the oak to burn. This means it cannot be done during round 4. At the end of the round that the Heroes set the oak on fire, fill all empty Stance slots with new Monsters. If the oak burns, the objective is cleared even if there are still Monsters at the end of round 4.
Those tremors you feel are unnatural, coming from the great unclean giants that live deep within the Weald. Are you brave enough to go into the forest, find them and kill them?
In Objective Rooms, spawn an Unclean Giant. These elder giants have 2 actions per round, so shuffle an additional Initiative Card in the Initiative Deck for them.

The monsters of the woods have grown restless, corrupting anything they touch. These horrific abominations shouldn't be left undisturbed. Venture into the Weald, find them and kill them all. But beware, because even a scratch from their claws can be lethal...
When you spawn a [weald] Monster in Battle, all Heroes suffer 1[blight] 2t.

Deep within the woods, there is a grove where stench and decay contaminates the air around it. These poisonous, noxious vapours will bring an end to us all. Find that place and eradicate it. Burn it to the ground. But hold your breath while doing so, lest you get infected for good...
When a Monster in a Lair is killed, all Heroes suffer 2[blight] 2t, 2[blight] 2t.

The murmurs in the wind originate from the haunted Weald. The whispering woods beckon all of us to our doom. Little can be done, and only you can bring an end to this nightmare. Heed the call, follow the murmurs and fell the cursed trees lest they drive us all insane.
At the start of each Battle round, Heroes suffer [stress] +1.
